card.name: Risk statements just before a hazard
card.fires_on: The word "no" in "there is no safe/lower limit", and commas or "occur" inside risk sentences, just before the named harm (cancer, infection, birth defects, respiratory depression).

modes.label: No safe level
modes.description: The word "no" in claims that no safe dose or lower limit exists.
modes.example: Every U.S. agency that regulates radiation exposure agrees that there is<< no>> safe dose no matter how small.

modes.label: Comma before a harm
modes.description: A comma in a warning sentence right before the harm or the word "theoretically".

modes.label: Can occur
modes.description: The verb "occur" in a statement that a serious reaction can happen at any time.
modes.example: While serious, life-threatening, or fatal respiratory depression can<< occur>> at any time during the use of acet

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about vulnerability, safety and harm, and away from "bad" words.
card.plain: It fires in warning sentences just before the text names a risk such as cancer, infection or birth defects.
